title: Entra My Sign-ins changes the Authenticator passkey registration flow from mid-November
summary: Microsoft Entra is updating the passkey registration experience in My Sign-ins for users who register a passkey in Microsoft Authenticator (MC1545694, published 9 November 2026). Users see an extra checkbox, updated link text and guided steps to open Authenticator and tap + to start registration; if direct registration in Authenticator fails, the new link text points them to the WebAuthn registration flow. General availability rolls out from mid-November 2026 and is expected to complete by end-November 2027.
why: Passkey rollouts live or die on self-service registration. Screenshots in your registration campaign, helpdesk scripts and the 'register a passkey first' onboarding flow will drift from what users actually see for up to a year while the rollout progresses.
todo: Update user-facing passkey registration guides and helpdesk scripts to mention the new checkbox and the Authenticator + button step.
Keep a WebAuthn fallback path documented, since the new link text explicitly routes failed Authenticator registrations there.
Expect mixed UI across users for months; avoid screenshots that only match one version.
